name: R CIN 450MG CAPSULE 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About R CIN 450MG CAPSULE

R CIN 450MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 450MG CAPSULE. R CIN 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

R CIN 450MG CAPSULE is used to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How R CIN 450MG CAPSULE Works

R CIN 450MG CAPSULE works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in a reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use R CIN 450MG CAPSULE

Take R CIN 450MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is recommended to take R CIN 450MG CAPSULE on an empty stomach. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: R CIN 450MG CAPSULEis not recommended for use in women who are pregnant and/or planning pregnancy as it can affect the growth of your unborn baby and may cause complications to the mother and baby after birth.
R CIN 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken by nursing women since it may pass to the baby through mother’s milk. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE.

It is not recommended to drive and use heavy machinery after taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE as it might make you feel dizzy or faint. It is recommended to take R CIN 450MG CAPSULE only after consultation with the doctor.
R CIN 450MG CAPSULE must be taken with caution if you are diagnosed with any kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE.
R CIN 450MG CAPSULE must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE.
It is not recommended to take R CIN 450MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Rifampicin and/or any other drug present in R CIN 450MG CAPSULE.

Others

R CIN 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

Before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Are underweight and/or malnourished
Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising
Wear contact lenses
Have deficiency of Vitamin K
If symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse
Have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor)

Use in Pediatrics:
R CIN 450MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it as they can decide the correct and required dosage, frequency and strength of R CIN 450MG CAPSULE based on age, disease condition and body weight of the child.

Use in Geriatrics:
R CIN 450MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking R CIN 450MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. saquinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage indigestion such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium carbonate)
Other medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. P-Aminosalicylic Acid)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. clopidrogel, warfarrin)
Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)
Medicines for heart problems or to control your heartbeat (Ex. atenolol, bisprolol), lower the blood pressure (Ex. diuretics like eplerenone)
Medicines used to manage thought disorders (Ex. antipsychotics like haloperidol), reduce anxiety (Ex. hypnotics-lorazepam), to induce sleep (Ex. barbiturates-phenobarbital), manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin), disease of motor neurons (Ex. riluzole)
Medicines used to manage various viral infections (Ex. indinavir, telaprevir, amprenavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, lopinavir, neviparine, daclatasvir, simeprevir, sofosbuvir and telaprevir)
Medicines used to manage fungal diseases (Ex. ketoconazole, clotrimazole), bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, cephalosporin), tapeworm infections (Ex. praziquantel)
Medicines used to lower the immune system response (Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Medicines used to manage pneumonia (Ex. atovaquone)
Medicines used for contraception (Ex. estrogen, progestogens)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. imatinib, irinotecan, ethinyloestradiol, levonorgestrel or dydrogesterone), for breast cancer or endometriosis (Ex. tamoxifen, gestrinone, toremifene)
Medicines used to manage thyroid gland problems (Ex. levothyroxine)
Medicines used to manage gout and other pains (Ex. aspirin, etoricoxib, codeine, morphine, fentanyl, pethidine, etoricoxib, aspirin and indomethacin)
Medicines used to manage inflammation in the body such as corticosteroids (Ex. hydrocortisone, betamethasone and prednisolone)
Medicines used during withdrawal from heroin (Ex. methadone)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used before surgery to relax the mind and body (Ex. halothane)
Medicines used for nausea (Ex. ondansetron, aprepitant)
Medicines used for malaria (Ex. quinine)
Medicines used to manage difficulty breathing and wheezing sound (Ex. theophylline)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of R CIN 450MG CAPSULE, visit the nearby hospital or consult your doctor immediately. Signs and symptoms of overdosage are feeling sick (nausea) along with vomiting and pain in abdomen, increased itch (pruritus), headache and increased lethargy, feeling of drowsiness, swelling of the face, eyes or eyelids, fast or uneven heartbeat, dizziness, fits and heart attack.

name: RHE FD Tablet 6's
introduction:
Introduction About RHE FD TABLET

RHE FD TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. RHE FD TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. RHE FD TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

RHE FD TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking RHE FD TABLET. The most common side effects of taking RHE FD TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RHE FD TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How RHE FD TABLET Works

RHE FD TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use RHE FD TABLET

Take RHE FD TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

B. Drug-Food interaction:

When taken with cheese or fish, RHE FD TABLET may cause redness, itching of the skin, hot feeling, rapid or pounding heartbeat, sweating, chills or clammy feeling, headache, and/or light-headedness.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of RHE FD TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may develop vomiting, gastrointestinal disturbances, fever, headache, dizziness, slurring of speech, hallucinations and/or visual disturbances.

name: COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET

COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET Works

COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET

Take COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of COMBUTOL 400MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Eye problems (like inflammation of the optic nerve, loss of vision sharpness)

Eye problems (like changes in the eyesight including loss of vision, blurred vision, eye pain, or color blindness)

name: R CIN 300MG CAPSULE 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About R CIN 300MG CAPSULE

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 300MG CAPSULE. R CIN 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in a reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken by nursing women since it may pass to the baby through mother’s milk. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE.

It is not recommended to drive and use heavy machinery after taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE as it might make you feel dizzy or faint. It is recommended to take R CIN 300MG CAPSULE only after consultation with the doctor.

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE.
It is not recommended to take R CIN 300MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Rifampicin and/or any other drug present in R CIN 300MG CAPSULE.

Others

R CIN 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

Before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Are underweight and/or malnourished
Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising
Wear contact lenses
Have deficiency of Vitamin K
If symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse
Have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor)

Use in Geriatrics:
R CIN 300MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking R CIN 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. saquinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage indigestion such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium carbonate)
Other medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. P-Aminosalicylic Acid)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. clopidrogel, warfarrin)
Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)
Medicines for heart problems or to control your heartbeat (Ex. atenolol, bisprolol), lower the blood pressure (Ex. diuretics like eplerenone)
Medicines used to manage thought disorders (Ex. antipsychotics like haloperidol), reduce anxiety (Ex. hypnotics-lorazepam), to induce sleep (Ex. barbiturates-phenobarbital), manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin), disease of motor neurons (Ex. riluzole)
Medicines used to manage various viral infections (Ex. indinavir, telaprevir, amprenavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, lopinavir, neviparine, daclatasvir, simeprevir, sofosbuvir and telaprevir)
Medicines used to manage fungal diseases (Ex. ketoconazole, clotrimazole), bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, cephalosporin), tapeworm infections (Ex. praziquantel)
Medicines used to lower the immune system response (Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Medicines used to manage pneumonia (Ex. atovaquone)
Medicines used for contraception (Ex. estrogen, progestogens)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. imatinib, irinotecan, ethinyloestradiol, levonorgestrel or dydrogesterone), for breast cancer or endometriosis (Ex. tamoxifen, gestrinone, toremifene)
Medicines used to manage thyroid gland problems (Ex. levothyroxine)
Medicines used to manage gout and other pains (Ex. aspirin, etoricoxib, codeine, morphine, fentanyl, pethidine, etoricoxib, aspirin and indomethacin)
Medicines used to manage inflammation in the body such as corticosteroids (Ex. hydrocortisone, betamethasone and prednisolone)
Medicines used during withdrawal from heroin (Ex. methadone)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used before surgery to relax the mind and body (Ex. halothane)
Medicines used for nausea (Ex. ondansetron, aprepitant)
Medicines used for malaria (Ex. quinine)
Medicines used to manage difficulty breathing and wheezing sound (Ex. theophylline)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of R CIN 300MG CAPSULE, visit the nearby hospital or consult your doctor immediately. Signs and symptoms of overdosage are feeling sick (nausea) along with vomiting and pain in abdomen, increased itch (pruritus), headache and increased lethargy, feeling of drowsiness, swelling of the face, eyes or eyelids, fast or uneven heartbeat, dizziness, fits and heart attack.

name: AKURIT 3 TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AKURIT 3 TABLET

AKURIT 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. AKURIT 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. AKURIT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

AKURIT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking AKURIT 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking AKURIT 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AKURIT 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How AKURIT 3 TABLET Works

AKURIT 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AKURIT 3 TABLET

Take AKURIT 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About AKT 2 TABLET

AKT 2 TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

AKT 2 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking AKT 2 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

AKT 2 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

AKT 2 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking AKT 2 TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About R CIN 150MG CAPSULE

R CIN 150MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 150MG CAPSULE. R CIN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 150MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

introduction:
Introduction About COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET

COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET Works

COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET

Take COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of COMBUTOL 600MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE

R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

R CINEX 450MG CAPSULE manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About MONITOR 3 TABLET

MONITOR 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. MONITOR 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. MONITOR 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

MONITOR 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking MONITOR 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking MONITOR 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONITOR 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How MONITOR 3 TABLET Works

MONITOR 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MONITOR 3 TABLET

Take MONITOR 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

COMBUTOL 200MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). introduction:
Introduction About COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET

COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of COMBUTOL 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TRAC 3 TABLET 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAC

TRAC is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. TRAC is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. TRAC should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

TRAC should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking TRAC. The most common side effects of taking TRAC are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAC
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAC Works

TRAC helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAC

Take TRAC as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Medicines to manage heart conditions (Ex. verapamil, digoxin)

introduction:
Introduction About THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET

THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET Works

THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET

Take THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of THEMIBUTOL 200MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About R CIN SYRUP

R CIN SYRUP contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used in the management of serious bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to people), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) along with other medicines and also manages haemophilus influenzae.

It is also used to stop meningitis (inflammation of the membranes and fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord) and haemophilus influenzae (in children aged 4 years or younger). Your doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before the management with R CIN SYRUP. R CIN SYRUP is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN SYRUP, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, feel numb or weak in your arms and legs (peripheral neuropathy), are underweight or malnourished. Also, inform your doctor if you have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily, symptoms of tuberculosis return/get worse or are wearing contact lenses.

R CIN SYRUP should be used with caution in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. R CIN SYRUP should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.

R CIN SYRUP works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in the reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.

Take R CIN SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. It is recommended to take R CIN SYRUP on an empty stomach. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Have diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Have peripheral neuropathy which is characterized by feeling of weakness and numbness in feet and hands

Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin.
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising easily
Wear contact lens
Notice worsening and/or return of your initial symptoms of tuberculosis

R CIN SYRUP must be taken in caution in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it as they can decide the correct and required dosage, frequency and strength of R CIN SYRUP based on age, disease condition and body weight of the child.

Use in Geriatrics:
R CIN SYRUP must be taken with caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking R CIN SYRUP.

Medicines used to manage indigestion such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium carbonate)

Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)

Medicines used to manage various viral infections (Ex. indinavir, telaprevir, amprenavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, lopinavir, neviparine, daclatasvir, simeprevir, sofosbuvir and telaprevir)

name: AKT 3 TABLET 1
introduction:
Introduction About AKT 3 TABLET

AKT 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. AKT 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. AKT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

AKT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking AKT 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking AKT 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AKT 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How AKT 3 TABLET Works

AKT 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AKT 3 TABLET

Take AKT 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Before taking AKT 3 TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

HIV protease inhibitors (Ex. efavirenz, nevirapine) (drugs used to manage HIV infection)
Aluminium hydroxide (medicine used to manage diseases related to the gastric acid)
Disulfiram (medicine used for the management of chronic alcoholism)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, fluconazole)

Immunosuppressant drugs (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus)
Medicines to manage heart conditions (Ex. verapamil, digoxin)
Medicines to manage blood lipids (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines to manage diabetes (Ex. glibenclamide)
Oral contraceptive pills (medicines used to manage unwanted pregnancy)
Medicines to manage epileptic seizures (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, valproate)
Medicines used to help you sleep (Ex. diazepam, flurazepam, triazolam, midazolam)
Medicines for the management of certain psychiatric conditions (Ex. chlorpromazine, haloperidol)
Medicines for management of blood clots (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used at surgery (Ex. alfentanil, enflurane)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, medicines for the management of inflammations and other diseases, such as asthma or rheumatoid arthritis)
Paracetamol (used for pain)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

When taken with cheese or fish, AKT 3 TABLET may cause redness, itching of the skin, hot feeling, rapid or pounding heartbeat, sweating, chills or clammy feeling, headache, and/or light-headedness.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of AKT 3 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may develop vomiting, gastrointestinal disturbances, fever, headache, dizziness, slurring of speech, hallucinations and/or visual disturbances.

introduction:
Introduction About ECOX 1GM TABLET

ECOX 1GM TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

ECOX 1GM TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking ECOX 1GM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. ECOX 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

ECOX 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ECOX 1GM TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ECOX 1GM TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How ECOX 1GM TABLET Works

ECOX 1GM TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use ECOX 1GM TABLET

Take ECOX 1GM TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ECOX 1GM TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ECOX 1GM TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: R CIN 600MG CAPSULE 3'S
introduction:
Introduction About R CIN 600MG CAPSULE

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 600MG CAPSULE. R CIN 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 600MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

How R CIN 600MG CAPSULE Works

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in a reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.

Take R CIN 600MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. R CIN 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken by nursing women since it may pass to the baby through mother’s milk. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE.

It is not recommended to drive and use heavy machinery after taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE as it might make you feel dizzy or faint. It is recommended to take R CIN 600MG CAPSULE only after consultation with the doctor.

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE.
It is not recommended to take R CIN 600MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Rifampicin and/or any other drug present in R CIN 600MG CAPSULE.

Others

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

Before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Are underweight and/or malnourished
Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising
Wear contact lenses
Have deficiency of Vitamin K
If symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse
Have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor)

R CIN 600MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it as they can decide the correct and required dosage, frequency and strength of R CIN 600MG CAPSULE based on age, disease condition and body weight of the child.

Use in Geriatrics:
R CIN 600MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking R CIN 600MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. saquinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage indigestion such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium carbonate)
Other medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. P-Aminosalicylic Acid)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. clopidrogel, warfarrin)
Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)
Medicines for heart problems or to control your heartbeat (Ex. atenolol, bisprolol), lower the blood pressure (Ex. diuretics like eplerenone)
Medicines used to manage thought disorders (Ex. antipsychotics like haloperidol), reduce anxiety (Ex. hypnotics-lorazepam), to induce sleep (Ex. barbiturates-phenobarbital), manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin), disease of motor neurons (Ex. riluzole)
Medicines used to manage various viral infections (Ex. indinavir, telaprevir, amprenavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, lopinavir, neviparine, daclatasvir, simeprevir, sofosbuvir and telaprevir)
Medicines used to manage fungal diseases (Ex. ketoconazole, clotrimazole), bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, cephalosporin), tapeworm infections (Ex. praziquantel)
Medicines used to lower the immune system response (Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Medicines used to manage pneumonia (Ex. atovaquone)
Medicines used for contraception (Ex. estrogen, progestogens)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. imatinib, irinotecan, ethinyloestradiol, levonorgestrel or dydrogesterone), for breast cancer or endometriosis (Ex. tamoxifen, gestrinone, toremifene)

MACOX 300MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. MACOX 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking MACOX 300MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. MACOX 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MACOX 300MG CAPSULE must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking MACOX 300MG CAPSULE.

Others

MACOX 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

Are diagnosed with diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Are underweight and/or malnourished
Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising
Wear contact lenses
Have deficiency of Vitamin K
If symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse
Have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor)

Use in Pediatrics:
MACOX 300MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it as they can decide the correct and required dosage, frequency and strength of MACOX 300MG CAPSULE based on age, disease condition and body weight of the child.

Use in Geriatrics:
MACOX 300MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking MACOX 300MG CAPSULE.

R CIN 150MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 150MG CAPSULE. R CIN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 150MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About AKT 3 TABLET

AKT 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. AKT 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. AKT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

AKT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking AKT 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking AKT 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AKT 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How AKT 3 TABLET Works

AKT 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AKT 3 TABLET

Take AKT 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Introduction About EBUTOL 800MG TABLET

EBUTOL 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

EBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking EBUTOL 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. EBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

EBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking EBUTOL 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBUTOL 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBUTOL 800MG TABLET Works

EBUTOL 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use EBUTOL 800MG TABLET

Take EBUTOL 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take EBUTOL 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of EBUTOL 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHIO 250MG TABLET

ETHIO 250MG TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. ETHIO 250MG TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking ETHIO 250MG TABLET.

ETHIO 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. ETHIO 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. introduction:
Introduction About R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE

R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord
Manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals

R CINEX 300MG CAPSULE manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET

SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET Works

SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET

Take SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SUNIBUTOL 800 TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: R CIN 150MG TABLET 20'S
introduction:
Introduction About R CIN 150MG TABLET

R CIN 150MG TABLET contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with R CIN 150MG TABLET. R CIN 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

R CIN 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. R CIN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)
usesDetails:

R CIN 150MG TABLET is used to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How R CIN 150MG TABLET Works

R CIN 150MG TABLET works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in a reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use R CIN 150MG TABLET

Take R CIN 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is recommended to take R CIN 150MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: R CIN 150MG TABLETis not recommended for use in women who are pregnant and/or planning pregnancy as it can affect the growth of your unborn baby and may cause complications to the mother and baby after birth.
R CIN 150MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by nursing women since it may pass to the baby through mother’s milk. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET.

It is not recommended to drive and use heavy machinery after taking R CIN 150MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or faint. It is recommended to take R CIN 150MG TABLET only after consultation with the doctor.
R CIN 150MG TABLET must be taken with caution if you are diagnosed with any kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET.
R CIN 150MG TABLET must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET.
It is not recommended to take R CIN 150MG TABLET if you are allergic to Rifampicin and/or any other drug present in R CIN 150MG TABLET.

Others

R CIN 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

Before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are diagnosed with diabetes (elevated level of sugar in blood)
Are underweight and/or malnourished
Are diagnosed with a blood disorder called Porphyria characterized by the appearance of purple colored rash on skin
Are prone to bleeding and/or bruising
Wear contact lenses
Have deficiency of Vitamin K
If symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse
Have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor)

Use in Pediatrics:
R CIN 150MG TABLET must be taken in caution in children below 2 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it as they can decide the correct and required dosage, frequency and strength of R CIN 150MG TABLET based on age, disease condition and body weight of the child.

Use in Geriatrics:
R CIN 150MG TABLET must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking R CIN 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. saquinavir, ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage indigestion such as antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide, magnesium carbonate)
Other medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. P-Aminosalicylic Acid)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. clopidrogel, warfarrin)
Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. atorvastatin, rosuvastatin)
Medicines for heart problems or to control your heartbeat (Ex. atenolol, bisprolol), lower the blood pressure (Ex. diuretics like eplerenone)
Medicines used to manage thought disorders (Ex. antipsychotics like haloperidol), reduce anxiety (Ex. hypnotics-lorazepam), to induce sleep (Ex. barbiturates-phenobarbital), manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin), disease of motor neurons (Ex. riluzole)
Medicines used to manage various viral infections (Ex. indinavir, telaprevir, amprenavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, lopinavir, neviparine, daclatasvir, simeprevir, sofosbuvir and telaprevir)
Medicines used to manage fungal diseases (Ex. ketoconazole, clotrimazole), bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, cephalosporin), tapeworm infections (Ex. praziquantel)
Medicines used to lower the immune system response (Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Medicines used to manage pneumonia (Ex. atovaquone)
Medicines used for contraception (Ex. estrogen, progestogens)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. imatinib, irinotecan, ethinyloestradiol, levonorgestrel or dydrogesterone), for breast cancer or endometriosis (Ex. tamoxifen, gestrinone, toremifene)
Medicines used to manage thyroid gland problems (Ex. levothyroxine)
Medicines used to manage gout and other pains (Ex. aspirin, etoricoxib, codeine, morphine, fentanyl, pethidine, etoricoxib, aspirin and indomethacin)
Medicines used to manage inflammation in the body such as corticosteroids (Ex. hydrocortisone, betamethasone and prednisolone)
Medicines used during withdrawal from heroin (Ex. methadone)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used before surgery to relax the mind and body (Ex. halothane)
Medicines used for nausea (Ex. ondansetron, aprepitant)
Medicines used for malaria (Ex. quinine)
Medicines used to manage difficulty breathing and wheezing sound (Ex. theophylline)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of R CIN 150MG TABLET, visit the nearby hospital or consult your doctor immediately. Signs and symptoms of overdosage are feeling sick (nausea) along with vomiting and pain in abdomen, increased itch (pruritus), headache and increased lethargy, feeling of drowsiness, swelling of the face, eyes or eyelids, fast or uneven heartbeat, dizziness, fits and heart attack.

name: TOLBIN 600mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TOLBIN 600MG TABLET

TOLBIN 600MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

TOLBIN 600MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking TOLBIN 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. TOLBIN 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

TOLBIN 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking TOLBIN 600MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLBIN 600MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLBIN 600MG TABLET Works

TOLBIN 600MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLBIN 600MG TABLET

Take TOLBIN 600MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TOLBIN 600MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TOLBIN 600MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ECOX 600MG TABLET

ECOX 600MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

ECOX 600MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking ECOX 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. ECOX 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

ECOX 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ECOX 600MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ECOX 600MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How ECOX 600MG TABLET Works

ECOX 600MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.

How to use ECOX 600MG TABLET

Take ECOX 600MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ECOX 600MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ECOX 600MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: COXINA 3 KIT 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About COXINA 3 KIT

COXINA 3 KIT is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. COXINA 3 KIT is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. COXINA 3 KIT should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

COXINA 3 KIT should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking COXINA 3 KIT. The most common side effects of taking COXINA 3 KIT are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of COXINA 3 KIT
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How COXINA 3 KIT Works

COXINA 3 KIT helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use COXINA 3 KIT

Take COXINA 3 KIT as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.
