A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking COXINA 3 KIT inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antibiotics such as voriconazole, clarithromycin (medicine used to manage fungal infections) 
HIV protease inhibitors (Ex. efavirenz, nevirapine) (drugs used to manage HIV infection)
Aluminium hydroxide (medicine used to manage diseases related to the gastric acid)
Disulfiram (medicine used for the management of chronic alcoholism)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, fluconazole)
Quinine (medicine used to manage malaria)
Immunosuppressant drugs (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus)
Medicines to manage heart conditions (Ex. verapamil, digoxin)
Medicines to manage blood lipids (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines to manage diabetes (Ex. glibenclamide)
Oral contraceptive pills (medicines used to manage unwanted pregnancy)
Medicines to manage epileptic seizures (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, valproate)
Medicines used to help you sleep (Ex. diazepam, flurazepam, triazolam, midazolam)
Medicines for the management of certain psychiatric conditions (Ex. chlorpromazine, haloperidol)
Medicines for management of blood clots (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used at surgery (Ex. alfentanil, enflurane)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, medicines for the management of inflammations and other diseases, such as asthma or rheumatoid arthritis)
Paracetamol (used for pain)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

When taken with cheese or fish, COXINA 3 KIT may cause redness, itching of the skin, hot feeling, rapid or pounding heartbeat, sweating, chills or clammy feeling, headache, and/or light-headedness.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of COXINA 3 KIT, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may develop vomiting, gastrointestinal disturbances, fever, headache, dizziness, slurring of speech, hallucinations and/or visual disturbances.

introduction:
Introduction About THEMIBUTOL

THEMIBUTOL contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

THEMIBUTOL is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking THEMIBUTOL, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. THEMIBUTOL is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

THEMIBUTOL is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking THEMIBUTOL are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of THEMIBUTOL
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How THEMIBUTOL Works

THEMIBUTOL contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.

Take THEMIBUTOL as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take THEMIBUTOL daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of THEMIBUTOL for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: XEED 3E TABLET 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About XEED 3E TABLET

XEED 3E TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. XEED 3E TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. XEED 3E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

XEED 3E TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking XEED 3E TABLET. The most common side effects of taking XEED 3E TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of XEED 3E TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How XEED 3E TABLET Works

XEED 3E TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use XEED 3E TABLET

Take XEED 3E TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHIDE TABLET

ETHIDE TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. ETHIDE TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking ETHIDE TABLET.

ETHIDE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. ETHIDE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. ETHIDE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) except in some specific disease conditions. Ask for your doctor’s advice before giving it to your child.

There is no information available on the use of ETHIDE TABLET in elderly patients, hence, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ETHIDE TABLET are stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, headache, dizziness, general weakness, yellowing of the skin and eyes, fever, fatigue, etc. If the symptoms do not improve, consult your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET

THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET Works

THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET

Take THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of THEMIBUTOL 600MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: R CINEX E TABLET 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About R CINEX E TABLET

R CINEX E TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. R CINEX E TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. R CINEX E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

R CINEX E TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking R CINEX E TABLET. The most common side effects of taking R CINEX E TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of R CINEX E TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How R CINEX E TABLET Works

R CINEX E TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use R CINEX E TABLET

Take R CINEX E TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Medicines to manage heart conditions (Ex. verapamil, digoxin)

Medicines for the management of certain psychiatric conditions (Ex. chlorpromazine, haloperidol)
Medicines for management of blood clots (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used at surgery (Ex. alfentanil, enflurane)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, medicines for the management of inflammations and other diseases, such as asthma or rheumatoid arthritis)
Paracetamol (used for pain)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

When taken with cheese or fish, R CINEX E TABLET may cause redness, itching of the skin, hot feeling, rapid or pounding heartbeat, sweating, chills or clammy feeling, headache, and/or light-headedness.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of R CINEX E TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may develop vomiting, gastrointestinal disturbances, fever, headache, dizziness, slurring of speech, hallucinations and/or visual disturbances.

KOXI 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). mechanismOfAction:
How KOXI 800MG TABLET Works

introduction:
Introduction About ETHOMID 250MG TABLET

ETHOMID 250MG TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. ETHOMID 250MG TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking ETHOMID 250MG TABLET.

ETHOMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. ETHOMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. ETHOMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) except in some specific disease conditions. Ask for your doctor’s advice before giving it to your child.

There is no information available on the use of ETHOMID 250MG TABLET in elderly patients, hence, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ETHOMID 250MG TABLET are stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, headache, dizziness, general weakness, yellowing of the skin and eyes, fever, fatigue, etc. If the symptoms do not improve, consult your doctor.

ETHOMID 250MG TABLET effectively reduces the tuberculosis infection by inhibiting the peptide synthesis, which is necessary for the bacteria, thereby it kills or suppresses the growth of disease-causing bacteria.

Do not stop taking ETHOMID 250MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE

R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

R CINEX 300/450MG CAPSULE manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.

TIBITOL 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.

Take TIBITOL 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TIBITOL 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIBITOL 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET

TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking TOLBIN 1000MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

name: RIMACTAZID 450/300mg Tablet 4's
introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord
Manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals

mechanismOfAction:
How RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET Works

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.

Take RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CONFEZ 3 TABLET

CONFEZ 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. CONFEZ 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. CONFEZ 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

CONFEZ 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking CONFEZ 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking CONFEZ 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONFEZ 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CONFEZ 3 TABLET Works

CONFEZ 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use CONFEZ 3 TABLET

Take CONFEZ 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOCOX E TABLET

MYCOCOX E TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. MYCOCOX E TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. MYCOCOX E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

MYCOCOX E TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking MYCOCOX E TABLET. The most common side effects of taking MYCOCOX E TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYCOCOX E TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How MYCOCOX E TABLET Works

MYCOCOX E TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.

How to use MYCOCOX E TABLET

Take MYCOCOX E TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: MACOX 600MG CAPSULE 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About MACOX 600MG CAPSULE

MACOX 600MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with MACOX 600MG CAPSULE. MACOX 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking MACOX 600MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

MACOX 600MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. MACOX 600MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

MACOX 600MG CAPSULE must be taken in caution in elderly patients (above the age of 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking MACOX 600MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET

ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET Works

ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET

Take ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ETHOPTI 1000MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE

RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE. RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. RIMACTANE 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.
uses: Infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae (causes flu) and Neisseria meningitides (causes meningitis)

Introduction About MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET

MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET.

MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) except in some specific disease conditions. Ask for your doctor’s advice before giving it to your child.

There is no information available on the use of MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET in elderly patients, hence, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET are stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, headache, dizziness, general weakness, yellowing of the skin and eyes, fever, fatigue, etc. If the symptoms do not improve, consult your doctor.

Do not stop taking MYCOTUF 250MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHAM 800MG TABLET

ETHAM 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

ETHAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking ETHAM 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. ETHAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

ETHAM 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ETHAM 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHAM 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHAM 800MG TABLET Works

ETHAM 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHAM 800MG TABLET

Take ETHAM 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ETHAM 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ETHAM 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: AKURIT 3 TABLET 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About AKURIT 3 TABLET

AKURIT 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. AKURIT 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. AKURIT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

AKURIT 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking AKURIT 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking AKURIT 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AKURIT 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How AKURIT 3 TABLET Works

AKURIT 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use AKURIT 3 TABLET

introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE

RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE contains Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibacterial. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as tuberculosis (affects the lungs), legionnaires disease (lung inflammation), brucellosis (infection spreading from animal to person), leprosy (causes skin lesions and nerve damage) and serious staphylococcal infections.

It also manages the infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitides (who are the carriers but do not show the symptoms), thereby managing and managing the onset of flu and meningitis. The doctor may ask you to take blood tests and liver function tests before starting management with RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE. RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).

Before taking RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE, it is recommended to inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney problems, diabetes, are underweight or malnourished, have a rare blood problem (porphyria), bleeding or a tendency to bruise easily. Also, inform your doctor if symptoms of tuberculosis return or get worse, are wearing contact lenses, are vitamin K deficient or have hypoprothrombinemia (deficient clotting factor).

RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children under 2 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects seen are nausea, vomiting, chills, fever. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.

How RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE Works

RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE works by managing protein synthesis and interferes with the enzymes present in the bacteria causing its death. This results in a reduction in the count of infection-causing bacteria, thereby managing bacterial infections.

RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE must be taken caution if you are diagnosed with any disease of the liver. Consult your doctor before taking RIMACTANE 450MG CAPSULE.

Have yellowish tinge to eyes and skin which may be indicative of jaundice

introduction:
Introduction About THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET

THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET Works

THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET

Take THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of THEMIBUTOL 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET

MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET Works

MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET

Take MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MYCOBUTOL 1GM TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Eye problems (like inflammation of the optic nerve, loss of vision sharpness)
Hyperuricemia (high level of uric acid in the blood)
The sensation of numbness, pins and needles
Low blood platelet count
Minor allergic reactions (signs include rashes, itching and swollen, pale red bumps or plaques (wheals) on the skin)
Severe allergic reaction (signs include difficulty breathing, sudden wheeziness, swelling of the face, eyes, lips, or throat, flushed appearance and irregular heartbeat)
Eye problems (like changes in the eyesight including loss of vision, blurred vision, eye pain, or color blindness)
Blistering or peeling of skin (including following exposure to sunlight), red or purple rash
Stevens-Johnson syndrome (signs include skin rash and itching with peeling and blistering and a sore mouth, hard lumps and red patches often on the backs of arms and hands)
Liver problem (signs include pale stools or skin or whites of eyes become yellow)
Kidney problem (signs include difficulty in urinating and low back pain)
Blood disorder (signs include unusual bleeding, bruising or discolored skin)

name: ANTIBIN Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ANTIBIN TABLET

ANTIBIN TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

ANTIBIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking ANTIBIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

ANTIBIN TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

ANTIBIN TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking ANTIBIN TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord
Manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANTIBIN TABLET
Manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord
Manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ANTIBIN TABLET Works

ANTIBIN TABLET manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ANTIBIN TABLET

Tablet, Capsule:

Take ANTIBIN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ANTIBIN TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the medicine depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of hypersensitivity (immune & inflammatory response) reactions such as skin rash, red itchy welt, shortness of breath, and/or wheezing
Loss of vision/hearing
Flu-like syndrome
Haemolytic anaemia (blood disorder)
Arthralgia (joint stiffness)
Signs of severe thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) such as excessive bruising, prolonged bleeding (from cuts), bleeding from gums, and/or blood in urine/stools
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ANTIBIN TABLET
Common
Signs of hypersensitivity (immune & inflammatory response) reactions such as skin rash, red itchy welt, shortness of breath, and/or wheezing
Loss of vision/hearing
Flu-like syndrome
Haemolytic anaemia (blood disorder)
Arthralgia (joint stiffness)
Rare

Stop taking ANTIBIN TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of severe thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) such as excessive bruising, prolonged bleeding (from cuts), bleeding from gums, and/or blood in urine/stools

ANTIBIN TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women since the medicine may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ANTIBIN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal insufficiency. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ANTIBIN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as cirrhosis of liver. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not take ANTIBIN TABLET if you are allergic to Isoniazid, Rifampicin, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Are suffering from pre-existing diseases

name: ETHOPTI 800mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET

ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET Works

ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET

Take ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ETHOPTI 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Eye problems (like inflammation of the optic nerve, loss of vision sharpness)
Hyperuricemia (high level of uric acid in the blood)
The sensation of numbness, pins and needles
Low blood platelet count
Minor allergic reactions (signs include rashes, itching and swollen, pale red bumps or plaques (wheals) on the skin)
Severe allergic reaction (signs include difficulty breathing, sudden wheeziness, swelling of the face, eyes, lips, or throat, flushed appearance and irregular heartbeat)
Eye problems (like changes in the eyesight including loss of vision, blurred vision, eye pain, or color blindness)
Blistering or peeling of skin (including following exposure to sunlight), red or purple rash
Stevens-Johnson syndrome (signs include skin rash and itching with peeling and blistering and a sore mouth, hard lumps and red patches often on the backs of arms and hands)
Liver problem (signs include pale stools or skin or whites of eyes become yellow)
Kidney problem (signs include difficulty in urinating and low back pain)
Blood disorder (signs include unusual bleeding, bruising or discolored skin)

introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET

RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET. The most common side effects of taking RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET Works

RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET

Take RIMACTAZID PLUS E TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: CONFEZ 3 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CONFEZ 3 TABLET

CONFEZ 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. CONFEZ 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. CONFEZ 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

CONFEZ 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking CONFEZ 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking CONFEZ 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONFEZ 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CONFEZ 3 TABLET Works

CONFEZ 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use CONFEZ 3 TABLET

Take CONFEZ 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

name: TUMID 250MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TUMID 250MG TABLET

TUMID 250MG TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. TUMID 250MG TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking TUMID 250MG TABLET.

TUMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. TUMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. TUMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) except in some specific disease conditions. Ask for your doctor’s advice before giving it to your child.

There is no information available on the use of TUMID 250MG TABLET in elderly patients, hence, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking TUMID 250MG TABLET are stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, headache, dizziness, general weakness, yellowing of the skin and eyes, fever, fatigue, etc. If the symptoms do not improve, consult your doctor.
uses: Manage active tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines

Manage active tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines
mechanismOfAction:
How TUMID 250MG TABLET Works

TUMID 250MG TABLET effectively reduces the tuberculosis infection by inhibiting the peptide synthesis, which is necessary for the bacteria, thereby it kills or suppresses the growth of disease-causing bacteria.

Always take TUMID 250MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will prescribe the correct dose and duration of TUMID 250MG TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TUMID 250MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: TOLBIN 800mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TOLBIN 800MG TABLET

TOLBIN 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

TOLBIN 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking TOLBIN 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. TOLBIN 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

TOLBIN 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking TOLBIN 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLBIN 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLBIN 800MG TABLET Works

TOLBIN 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use TOLBIN 800MG TABLET

Take TOLBIN 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TOLBIN 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TOLBIN 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CONCOX 800MG TABLET

CONCOX 800MG TABLET contains ethambutol, which belongs to the group of medicines called antituberculous drugs. Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disorder caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The bacteria usually attack the lungs, but they can attack any part of the body, such as the kidney, spine and brain. This bacterium can spread from one person to another through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.

CONCOX 800MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with optic neuritis (eye problems). Before taking CONCOX 800MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, diabetes or blood disorders. CONCOX 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and breastfeeding women.

CONCOX 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 13 years of age and it should be used with caution in children 13 years of age and older and elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects of taking CONCOX 800MG TABLET are inflammation of the optic nerve and loss of sharpness of vision. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONCOX 800MG TABLET
Manage pulmonary tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CONCOX 800MG TABLET Works

CONCOX 800MG TABLET contains Ethambutol which is a bacteriostatic agent that works by inhibiting the arabinosyl transferase, an enzyme that polymerizes arabinose into arabinan and then arabinogalactan, a mycobacterial cell wall constituent. This manages cell division.
usageDetails:
How to use CONCOX 800MG TABLET

Take CONCOX 800MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take CONCOX 800MG TABLET daily at the same time. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CONCOX 800MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ETHIOBIN 250mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET

ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET contains Ethionamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular drugs. It is used in the management of active tuberculosis caused by a bacteria called M. tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines. ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET is generally used in combination with other medicines.

Tuberculosis is a serious bacterial infectious disease that affects the lungs. The symptoms are unusual loss of weight, fever, cough, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, loss of appetite, night sweats, etc. Your doctor may monitor your blood sugar level, thyroid function and visual activity regularly while taking ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET.

ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease. ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) except in some specific disease conditions. Ask for your doctor’s advice before giving it to your child.

There is no information available on the use of ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET in elderly patients, hence, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET are stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, headache, dizziness, general weakness, yellowing of the skin and eyes, fever, fatigue, etc. If the symptoms do not improve, consult your doctor.
uses: Manage active tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET
Manage active tuberculosis resistant to other antibiotics (Ex. isoniazid, rifampicin) or when the patient is intolerant to other medicines
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET Works

ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET effectively reduces the tuberculosis infection by inhibiting the peptide synthesis, which is necessary for the bacteria, thereby it kills or suppresses the growth of disease-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET

Always take ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will prescribe the correct dose and duration of ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ETHIOBIN 250MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: TICINEX Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TICINEX TABLET

TICINEX TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

TICINEX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking TICINEX TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

TICINEX TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

TICINEX TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking TICINEX TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals

TICINEX TABLET manages tuberculosis infection, where Rifampicin works by inactivating bacterial enzyme (RNA-polymerase) resulting in its destruction and Isoniazid works by managing the bacteria to form its own protective covering leading to its death thus managing tuberculosis in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET

OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking OPTIMAT 450/300 TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTAZID E TABLET

RIMACTAZID E TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. RIMACTAZID E TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. RIMACTAZID E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

RIMACTAZID E TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking RIMACTAZID E TABLET. The most common side effects of taking RIMACTAZID E TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIMACTAZID E TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How RIMACTAZID E TABLET Works

RIMACTAZID E TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.

How to use RIMACTAZID E TABLET

Take RIMACTAZID E TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking RIMACTAZID E TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antibiotics such as voriconazole, clarithromycin (medicine used to manage fungal infections) 
HIV protease inhibitors (Ex. efavirenz, nevirapine) (drugs used to manage HIV infection)
Aluminium hydroxide (medicine used to manage diseases related to the gastric acid)
Disulfiram (medicine used for the management of chronic alcoholism)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, fluconazole)
Quinine (medicine used to manage malaria)
Immunosuppressant drugs (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus)
Medicines to manage heart conditions (Ex. verapamil, digoxin)
Medicines to manage blood lipids (Ex. simvastatin)
Medicines to manage diabetes (Ex. glibenclamide)
Oral contraceptive pills (medicines used to manage unwanted pregnancy)
Medicines to manage epileptic seizures (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, valproate)
Medicines used to help you sleep (Ex. diazepam, flurazepam, triazolam, midazolam)
Medicines for the management of certain psychiatric conditions (Ex. chlorpromazine, haloperidol)
Medicines for management of blood clots (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used at surgery (Ex. alfentanil, enflurane)
Corticosteroids (Ex. prednisolone, medicines for the management of inflammations and other diseases, such as asthma or rheumatoid arthritis)
Paracetamol (used for pain)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

When taken with cheese or fish, RIMACTAZID E TABLET may cause redness, itching of the skin, hot feeling, rapid or pounding heartbeat, sweating, chills or clammy feeling, headache, and/or light-headedness.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of RIMACTAZID E TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may develop vomiting, gastrointestinal disturbances, fever, headache, dizziness, slurring of speech, hallucinations and/or visual disturbances.

introduction:
Introduction About RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET is a combination of Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antitubercular agents. It is used to manage tuberculosis and bacterial infection of membranes covering the brain, and spinal cord. It is also used to manage contagious disease of skin, nerves, mucous membrane, and other conditions in affected individuals.

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Isoniazid, and/or Rifampicin. Before taking RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery, and/or suffering from pre-existing diseases, liver problems (such as cirrhosis of liver)/kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency).

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also advised to be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65years and above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIMACTAZID 450/300MG TABLET are hypersensitivity reaction (associated with signs such as skin rash, red itchy welt, and/or shortness of breath), loss of vision/hearing, flu-like syndrome, and/or arthralgia (joint stiffness). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: MONTO 3 TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MONTO 3 TABLET

MONTO 3 TABLET is a combination of Ethambutol, Isoniazid and Rifampicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antituberculosis agents respectively. It is used for the initial management of tuberculosis. Tuberculosis (TB) is a bacterial infection which spreads through inhaling tiny droplets from the coughs or sneezes of an infected person. Symptoms such as persistent cough with sputum and blood, weight loss, night sweats, high temperature, tiredness and fatigue, loss of appetite and swelling in the neck.

Your doctor will perform some regular blood tests such as liver function test, visual acuity, uric acid level to monitor any changes in your body. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may cause liver damage. MONTO 3 TABLET is not recommended in patients with acute liver disease, drug-induced liver disease, inflammation of the optic nerve (optic neuritis) and body weight of less than 20 kg. MONTO 3 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with hepatitis and kidney disease, suffer from tingling in the hands and feet (peripheral neuropathy), HIV infection, hypersensitive to ethionamide or niacin (nicotinic acid), epilepsy or a history of psychiatric disease and diabetes or porphyria.

MONTO 3 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking MONTO 3 TABLET. The most common side effects of taking MONTO 3 TABLET are peripheral neuropathy (sensations of tingling, pricking, or numbness of the skin, especially in the feet and hands), increased liver enzymes & uric acid levels in blood, flushing, reddish discoloration of body fluids such as urine, sputum, tears, saliva and sweat, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting or skin reactions. Consult your physician if you experience any of the above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONTO 3 TABLET
Used to manage tuberculosis
mechanismOfAction:
How MONTO 3 TABLET Works

MONTO 3 TABLET helps to manage tuberculosis, where Ethambutol has bacteriostatic properties that inhibits cell wall synthesis. Isoniazid destroys and manages the growth of bacteria. Rifampicin acts via the inhibition of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, leading to a suppression of RNA synthesis and cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use MONTO 3 TABLET

Take MONTO 3 TABLET as advised by your physician. Take the medicine, with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of infection.
